t: From Dunning-Kruger to Determinism: Future-Proofing Skills in the Age of AI
s: This article argues that true skill future-proofing against AI-driven misinformation requires embracing verifiable, reproducible realities ('Bedrock') by becoming a 'Full-Stack Skeptic' and leveraging tools like NixOS that guarantee deterministic outputs.
sub: Evolutionary basis of self-deception and confident overestimation (Dunning-Kruger, Robert Trivers).
Shift from broadcast media to algorithmic manipulation and surveillance capitalism (Postman, Zuboff).
AI's role in amplifying 'confident but wrong' phenomena through hallucinations.
NixOS and immutable infrastructure as technical 'Bedrock' for reproducible truth.
The 'Full-Stack Skeptic' approach to information consumption and digital sovereignty.
